# acloud_cloud_provider_regions (Data Source)

List all regions available for the cloud provider for the organisation

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "acloud_cloud_provider_regions" "aws" {
  cloud_provider = "aws"
}

output "available_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.acloud_cloud_provider_regions.aws.regions : r.slug if r.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Slug of the cloud provider, for example `aws`.

### Optional

- `organisation` (String) Slug of the Organisation. Defaults to the `organisation` of the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `regions` (List of Object) Regions of the cloud provider, each with `name`, `slug` and `available` (whether the region can be used). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
